subject: crtf-d
title: (R)CRTF.D.----POL.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 250 (CMOA(II)-8). CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: DEC (decentralization) and INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INT: DOC (documentation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From DOC: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) and STF (source transfer). From PROG-SIGN: DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center). From STF: DE-SPTL (despiritualization). From DIS-C-CT: MT-INFO (multi-information). From DE-SPTL: TRS (transition). From TRS: EXPM (expansionism).
